# Divers Hub

> Divers Hub (divers-hub.com) is a free scuba diving planner for South Florida and the Florida Keys. It combines the trip calendars of local dive operators into one daily schedule, and adds a database of dive sites, marine forecasts and dive-planning tools.

Coverage runs from Stuart to Key West. Contact: support@divers-hub.com

## Plan a dive
- [Today's dive trips](https://divers-hub.com/Trips): every scheduled boat dive from participating South Florida operators, by date, with departure time and site.
- [Dive operators](https://divers-hub.com/Operators): dive shops and charter boats with location, boats, sites they visit and contact details.
- [Beach diving](https://divers-hub.com/BeachDiving): shore diving conditions and tides for Fort Lauderdale and West Palm Beach.
- [Marine forecasts](https://divers-hub.com/Weather/jupiter): 7-day wave, wind and tide forecasts for South Florida dive towns.

## Dive sites
- [Top rated dive sites](https://divers-hub.com/DiveSites): reefs and wrecks ranked by how often boats visit and diver ratings.
- [Wreck wiki](https://divers-hub.com/WreckSites): Florida shipwrecks and artificial reefs with depth, history, certification level and photos.
- Each site has its own page at https://divers-hub.com/SiteDetails/{site-name}, for example [Lady Luck](https://divers-hub.com/SiteDetails/lady-luck) and [Spiegel Grove](https://divers-hub.com/SiteDetails/spiegel-grove).

## Tools
- [Gas mix calculator](https://divers-hub.com/gasplanning): nitrox and trimix best-mix and MOD calculator.
- [Decompression planner](https://divers-hub.com/DecoPlanner): free dive and deco schedule planner.
- [Online dive waivers](https://divers-hub.com/Waivers)

## Guides
- [Blog](https://divers-hub.com/Blog): local guides on wrecks, seasons, lobster season, lionfish, nitrox and more.
